definitions.gloss: third (in a series), C (in a grading system)
definitions.explanation: The third of the ten Heavenly Stems (天干), used as an ordinal marker meaning 'third' in traditional ranking systems. Equivalent to 'C' in Western A/B/C grading. Part of the sequence 甲 (A) → 乙 (B) → 丙 (C).

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丙|へい}だった。
{甲|こう}・⟦{乙|おつ}→乙：23000_otsu⟧・{丙|へい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They are rated in order of A, B, and C.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甲|こう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{売主|うりぬし}、⟦{乙|おつ}→乙：23000_otsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{買主|かいぬし}、{丙|へい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仲介者|ちゅうかいしゃ}→仲介者：23919_chuukaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧。
examples.english: In the contract, Party A is the seller, Party B is the buyer, and Party C is the intermediary.

notes:
USAGE:
Part of the traditional ranking sequence: {甲|こう} (first/A), ⟦{乙|おつ}→乙：23000_otsu⟧ (second/B), {丙|へい} (third/C). Used in legal documents to label parties, in old grading systems, and in traditional contexts. Less common in modern everyday use, where A/B/C or numerical grades are preferred.

TEN HEAVENLY STEMS:
{丙|へい} is the third of the {十干|じっかん} (Ten Heavenly Stems): {甲|こう}、{乙|おつ}、{丙|へい}、{丁|てい}、{戊|ぼ}、{己|き}、{庚|こう}、{辛|しん}、{壬|じん}、{癸|き}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甲|こう}{乙|おつ}{丙|へい}: A, B, C (ranking series)
- {丙|へい}{種|しゅ}: C-class, third category
